name: TransNeRF
aliases: Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields for Novel View Synthesis with Transformer
definition: A generalizable neural radiance field method that learns a generic radiance field representation for novel scenes using an encoder-decoder Transformer framework, avoiding per-scene optimization.
summary: TransNeRF is a generalizable neural radiance field method that synthesizes novel views using a Transformer framework to aggregate multi-view information, eliminating per-scene optimization.
